title: Scheme-isomorphism equivalence on independent derived categories
statement: Let X and Y be schemes in universe u [def-pc-scheme], s : X ≅ Y, and choose derived categories of their module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] with independent morphism universes w₁ and w₂. There exists an equivalence e : D(O_X) ≌ D(O_Y) and a natural isomorphism Q_X ⋙ e.functor ≅ (s_* on cochain complexes) ⋙ Q_Y. The termwise functor uses the actual SheafOfModules.pushforward s.hom.toRingCatSheafHom, not a chosen derived functor.

proof.text: Compose Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr of s.hom_inv_id and s.inv_hom_id, and pushforwardId to obtain a module-sheaf equivalence, with actual pushforwards as its functor and inverse. Equivalence.mk adjusts the triangle identity without changing these functors.

proof.text: Equivalence functors preserve limits and colimits and are additive. Apply Equivalence.mapHomologicalComplex and Functor.mapDerivedCategory to both sides. The factors isomorphisms and the termwise unit and counit produce the two comparisons required by Localization.equivalence, which gives an equivalence on the chosen derived categories. Its forward factorization is exactly Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_scheme_iso_derived_equivalence {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ≅ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] :
    ∃ e : schemeDerivedCategory X ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y,
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.functor ≅
        (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
          (SheafOfModules.pushforward s.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
          ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
